name: Channel demo
description: A whole channel with nothing behind it: two libraries (Films and Series) whose catalog is a table this plugin carries, a card on the Channels shelf, and a page whose default layout ships with the plugin and belongs to the household afterwards. It reaches nothing on the internet and needs nothing configured, so a harness and a curious owner get the same working channel. Its resolver has no media and says so in a sentence rather than handing back an address that would stall. minHostVersion is 0.65.0 because an older server does not know the channel family at all: keep that number equal to the release that carries channels, read from the published manifest at release time and never from a snapshot in the docs.
author: Multipass

settings.label: Which films to list
settings.help: Narrows what a sync of this library enumerates. It is here to prove that a setting belongs to the LIBRARY, not to the plugin: the Series library beside it has its own field and never sees this one.

settings.label: Include specials
settings.help: Lists the season 0 episodes as well. Season 0 is a real season here, the way a folder scan treats one.
